title: Create: Enhanced Emerald Production
body:
# Automate Emeralds with Create

Have you ever wanted a less laggy emerald farm? Here it is! This mod lets you automate and crush Veridium to make Emeralds and Copper.

## Recipes
### Veridium:
> Mix in a mixer over a heated blaze burner:
> -    1x Tuff
> -    1x Flint
> -    1x Quartz

### Emerald:
> Crush Veridium for 25% chance.
